verdict.rationale: Smooth is built for programmatic, non-interactive use. It offers a REST API for browser automation, an SDK that runs a task in a few lines of code, polling-based task status, cancel/list endpoints, and structured outputs for deterministic downstream code. Its CLI works with any agent that can run shell commands. Together these support headless automation scripts, but the evidence never explicitly addresses CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive auth for pipelines (browser profiles require a manual first login), independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
